title: 3 month challenge (1st week done)
author: PuzzleheadedBlood184
selftext:
Hi everyone 👋🏼

As some of you know, around 15 days ago I took a hard hit from life and locked up in a room for appx 3 months  and I decided to built a game from scratch. -- I have payments that takes all my money so I have to save a lot living in a small room. I also have only 150-200$ worth basic laptop, monitor from marketplace and camping table . (Computer has 150 gb disk total 🥲, also it doesn't even run screen recording without crashing so I had to record like this.. 😂)

The game is going great so far. It needs some polishing and I have still a lot of ideas I wanna add into the game. But in this video you can see how day starts in our game. I wanted to show the progress and I will share more. Both day and night cycle is completely playable and full game loop is working. I am really excited how this will end up 3 months after. But sharing the process will be fun.

I will also share night cycle here in the replies. And don't worry, the whole kitchen and combat system is connected and you won't feel like 2 different game.

Ask me any questions, about life or the game 🫶🏼
